spatial_reference: The cleaned cup spot is the episode-specific world-coordinate spot where the cup was originally placed; it is not left/right in a camera image. The temporary cup offset and the sponge's post-wipe drop position are episode details and are not exposed as subtask labels.
high_level_instruction: Start with the sponge already grasped. Wipe the dirty dining-table spot, then place the cup onto the cleaned spot.

wipe_spot.label: wipe the dirty spot with the sponge

place_sponge.label: put down the sponge on the dining table

place_cup.label: return the cup to the spot just wiped with the sponge
